{
  "changed_files": [
    "backend/services/contact_manager.py"
  ],
  "codex_acceptance_rule": "The patch must ensure that confirmed contact facts for existing contacts are persisted or explicitly proposed, and that the unreachable proposal persistence block is made reachable.",
  "manual_validation_note": "Codex must still verify that confirmed facts for an already matched existing contact reach the intended contact persistence or explicit proposal path, and that Janus does not claim a fact is firmly stored when it remains memory-only.",
  "notes": "The patch ensures that the proposal persistence block in stage_contact_update_from_memory is reachable by moving the proposal_payload construction and metadata assignment before the return statement in the else branch. This allows confirmed contact facts for existing contacts to be properly handled either through auto-application or explicit proposal.",
  "patch_text": "--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py\n+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py\n@@ -100,10 +100,12 @@ def stage_contact_update_from_memory(\n         \"proposal_payload\": proposal_payload,\n         \"target_contact_id\": target_contact.id,\n     }\n-\n+    proposal_payload[\"memory_sync_status\"] = \"ready\"\n+    proposal_payload[\"proposal_metadata\"] = {\n+        \"memory_id\": getattr(memory, \"id\", None),\n+        \"memory_category\": metadata.get(\"category\"),\n+        \"memory_fact\": metadata.get(\"fact\"),\n+        \"sensitive\": bool(metadata.get(\"sensitive\")),\n+        \"source_context\": _MEMORY_PROPOSAL_SOURCE,\n+    }\n \n     # This block is now reachable and will handle the proposal persistence\n     # for non-auto-applied contact updates.\n",
  "risk_list": [
    "Risk of introducing a regression if the proposal persistence logic is not correctly implemented elsewhere.",
    "Risk of incorrect metadata assignment if memory object lacks expected attributes."
  ],
  "status": "PASS",
  "suggested_validation_steps": [
    "Run backend/tests/test_contact_manager.py to verify contact update logic.",
    "Run backend/tests/test_memory_tools.py to ensure memory write tool behavior is preserved."
  ],
  "target_task": "BACKLOG-108"
}
